description: Search the cached structure tree by class and/or name substring. Returns slim records (id, class, name, parent).

drawing.description: The drawing this call works on. "new" opens a new, empty drawing, and the answer names its id; from then on pass that id (e.g. "d-k3v9q2xa") in every call of this conversation about that model. A drawing belongs to the conversation that opened it: no other conversation can see or change it.

name.description: Match nodes whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).

name: find
